WITH first_price AS (
  SELECT p.close AS first_close
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.symbol = 'AAPL' AND p.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  ORDER BY p.date ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
last_price AS (
  SELECT p.close AS last_close
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.symbol = 'AAPL' AND p.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  ORDER BY p.date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (lp.last_close / fp.first_close - 1) AS total_return
FROM first_price fp, last_price lp

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT p.symbol,
         MIN(p.date) AS first_date,
         MAX(p.date) AS last_date
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY p.symbol
),
first_last AS (
  SELECT b.symbol,
         p_first.close AS first_close,
         p_last.close AS last_close
  FROM bounds b
  JOIN prices p_first ON p_first.symbol = b.symbol AND p_first.date = b.first_date
  JOIN prices p_last ON p_last.symbol = b.symbol AND p_last.date = b.last_date
)
SELECT fl.symbol,
       (fl.last_close / fl.first_close) - 1 AS total_return
FROM first_last fl
ORDER BY total_return DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH end_prices AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.close AS close_end
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.date = DATE '2026-11-16'
)
SELECT e.symbol,
       e.close_end / s.close_start - 1 AS pct_return
FROM end_prices e
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT p.close AS close_start
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.symbol = e.symbol
    AND p.date <= DATE '2026-10-17'
  ORDER BY p.date DESC
  LIMIT 1
) s ON true
ORDER BY pct_return DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH start AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.close AS start_close
 FROM prices p
 JOIN (
   SELECT symbol, MAX(date) AS date
   FROM prices
   WHERE date <= '2025-12-31'
   GROUP BY symbol
 ) s ON p.symbol = s.symbol AND p.date = s.date
),
end AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.close AS end_close
 FROM prices p
 WHERE p.date = '2026-11-16'
)
SELECT s.symbol, (e.end_close / s.start_close) - 1 AS ytd_return
FROM start s
JOIN end e ON s.symbol = e.symbol
ORDER BY ytd_return DESC

SELECT v.date, v.total_volume
FROM v

LIMIT 1

WITH r AS (
 SELECT t.sector, (p.high - p.low) / p.open AS range_ratio
 FROM prices p
 JOIN tickers t ON t.symbol = p.symbol
 WHERE p.date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT r.sector, AVG(r.range_ratio) AS avg_range
FROM r
GROUP BY r.sector
ORDER BY AVG(r.range_ratio) DESC

WITH r AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.date, p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
 FROM prices p
 WHERE p.symbol = 'NVDA'
)
SELECT r.date, r.pct_change
FROM r
WHERE r.pct_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.pct_change ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH r AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.date, p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
 FROM prices p
 WHERE p.symbol = 'TSLA'
)
SELECT r.date, r.pct_change
FROM r
WHERE r.pct_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.pct_change DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH sma AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.date,
        AVG(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sma_50
 FROM prices p
 WHERE p.symbol = 'AAPL'
)
SELECT sma.date, sma.sma_50
FROM sma
WHERE sma.date = (SELECT MAX(p.date) FROM prices p WHERE p.symbol = 'AAPL')

WITH r AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.date,
   p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
 FROM prices p
 WHERE p.date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT r.symbol,
       MIN(r.pct_change) AS drop_pct
FROM r
WHERE r.pct_change IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.symbol
ORDER BY drop_pct ASC

WITH up AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.date,
        CASE WHEN p.close > lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_up
 FROM prices p
 WHERE p.symbol = 'AAPL' AND p.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
),
grp AS (
 SELECT u.symbol, u.date, u.is_up,
        SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_up = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY u.date) AS grp_id
 FROM up u
)
SELECT MAX(s.streak) AS longest_up_streak
FROM (
 SELECT g.grp_id, COUNT(*) AS streak
 FROM grp g
 WHERE g.is_up = 1
 GROUP BY g.grp_id
) s

WITH first AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date AS first_date, p.close AS first_close
  FROM prices p
  JOIN (
    SELECT p2.symbol, MIN(p2.date) AS min_date
    FROM prices p2
    WHERE p2.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY p2.symbol
  ) f ON p.symbol = f.symbol AND p.date = f.min_date
),
last AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date AS last_date, p.close AS last_close
  FROM prices p
  JOIN (
    SELECT p2.symbol, MAX(p2.date) AS max_date
    FROM prices p2
    WHERE p2.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY p2.symbol
  ) l ON p.symbol = l.symbol AND p.date = l.max_date
),
returns AS (
  SELECT f.symbol, (l.last_close / f.first_close - 1) AS total_return
  FROM first f
  JOIN last l ON f.symbol = l.symbol
)
SELECT sector, symbol, total_return
FROM (
  SELECT t.sector, r.symbol, r.total_return,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.sector ORDER BY r.total_return DESC) AS rn
  FROM returns r
  JOIN tickers t ON r.symbol = t.symbol
) sub
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY sector

WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    p.symbol,
    p.date,
    p.close,
    MAX(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS peak_close,
    (p.close / MAX(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - 1) AS drawdown
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.symbol = 'META'
)
SELECT MIN(r.drawdown) AS max_drawdown FROM r

WITH r AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date,
         p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.symbol = 'TSLA'
)
SELECT stddev_samp(sub.pct_change) AS volatility
FROM (
  SELECT r.pct_change
  FROM r
  WHERE r.pct_change IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY r.date DESC
  LIMIT 20
) sub

WITH f AS (
  SELECT fl.symbol, fl.filed_at,
         (SELECT p.close FROM prices p WHERE p.symbol = fl.symbol AND p.date < fl.filed_at ORDER BY p.date DESC LIMIT 1) AS prior_close
  FROM filings fl
  WHERE fl.form_type = '8-K'
)
SELECT f.symbol, f.filed_at
FROM f
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM LATERAL (
    SELECT p.close
    FROM prices p
    WHERE p.symbol = f.symbol AND p.date >= f.filed_at
    ORDER BY p.date ASC
    LIMIT 3
  ) np
  WHERE np.close < f.prior_close * 0.95
)
ORDER BY f.filed_at, f.symbol

WITH r AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.date, p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
 FROM prices p
 WHERE p.symbol = 'AAPL'
)
SELECT f.filed_at AS date, r.pct_change AS close_to_close_return
FROM filings f
JOIN r ON r.symbol = f.symbol AND r.date = f.filed_at
WHERE f.symbol = 'AAPL' AND f.form_type = '10-K'
ORDER BY f.filed_at

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date,
         (p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1) AS pct_change
  FROM prices p
),
big_moves AS (
  SELECT f.symbol, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM filings f
  JOIN daily d ON d.symbol = f.symbol AND d.date = f.filed_at
  WHERE f.form_type = '8-K'
    AND d.pct_change IS NOT NULL
    AND ABS(d.pct_change) > 0.03
  GROUP BY f.symbol
)
SELECT t.symbol, COALESCE(b.cnt, 0) AS eightk_big_move
FROM tickers t
LEFT JOIN big_moves b ON b.symbol = t.symbol
ORDER BY eightk_big_move DESC, t.symbol

WITH r AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date, p.close / LAG(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
  FROM prices p
),
f AS (
  SELECT f.symbol, f.filed_at AS date
  FROM filings f
  WHERE f.form_type = '8-K'
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN f.symbol IS NOT NULL THEN 'with_8k' ELSE 'without_8k' END AS filing_flag,
  AVG(ABS(r.pct_change)) AS avg_abs_return
FROM r
LEFT JOIN f ON r.symbol = f.symbol AND r.date = f.date
WHERE r.pct_change IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY filing_flag
ORDER BY filing_flag

WITH r AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date, p.close,
         lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) AS prev_close,
         p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
  FROM prices p
)
SELECT n.symbol, n.headline, r.pct_change
FROM news n
JOIN r ON r.symbol = n.symbol AND r.date = n.published_at::date
WHERE r.pct_change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.date, n.symbol

WITH latest_prices AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.close
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices)
)
SELECT DISTINCT n.symbol, t.name, lp.close AS latest_close
FROM news n
JOIN tickers t ON t.symbol = n.symbol
JOIN latest_prices lp ON lp.symbol = n.symbol

WITH r AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.date,
        p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
 FROM prices p
 WHERE p.date >= '2025-01-01' AND p.date <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT r.symbol,
       -MIN(r.pct_change) AS max_drop_pct
FROM r
WHERE r.pct_change IS NOT NULL AND r.pct_change < 0
GROUP BY r.symbol
ORDER BY max_drop_pct DESC
LIMIT 1000

select * from (
WITH up AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date,
    CASE WHEN p.close > lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_up
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.symbol = 'AAPL' AND p.date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT u.symbol, u.date, u.is_up,
    SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_up = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY u.date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp
  FROM up u
)
SELECT MAX(streak_len) AS longest_streak
FROM (
  SELECT s.grp, COUNT(*) AS streak_len
  FROM streaks s
  WHERE s.is_up = 1
  GROUP BY s.grp
) t
) as limited limit 1000

select * from (
WITH first_last AS (
  SELECT t.sector, t.symbol,
    f.first_close,
    l.last_close,
    (l.last_close / f.first_close) - 1 AS total_return
  FROM tickers t
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.close AS first_close
    FROM prices p
    WHERE p.symbol = t.symbol
      AND p.date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    ORDER BY p.date ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) f ON true
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.close AS last_close
    FROM prices p
    WHERE p.symbol = t.symbol
      AND p.date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    ORDER BY p.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) l ON true
)
SELECT fl.sector, fl.symbol, fl.total_return
FROM (
  SELECT fl.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fl.sector ORDER BY fl.total_return DESC) AS rn
  FROM first_last fl
) fl
WHERE fl.rn = 1
ORDER BY fl.sector
) as limited limit 1000

select * from (
WITH d AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date, p.close,
         MAX(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS peak
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.symbol = 'META'
)
SELECT MIN((d.close - d.peak) / d.peak) AS max_drawdown
FROM d
) as limited limit 1000

select * from (
WITH r AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date, p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS ret
  FROM prices p
  WHERE p.symbol = 'TSLA' AND p.date <= DATE '2026-11-16'
),
recent AS (
  SELECT r.ret
  FROM r
  WHERE r.ret IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY r.date DESC
  LIMIT 20
)
SELECT stddev_samp(recent.ret) AS volatility FROM recent
) as limited limit 1000

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.symbol, f.filed_at
  FROM filings f
  WHERE f.form_type = '8-K'
), prior AS (
  SELECT f.symbol, f.filed_at, p.close AS prior_close
  FROM f
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.close
    FROM prices p
    WHERE p.symbol = f.symbol AND p.date < f.filed_at
    ORDER BY p.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) p ON true
)
SELECT prior.symbol, prior.filed_at
FROM prior
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM LATERAL (
    SELECT p2.close
    FROM prices p2
    WHERE p2.symbol = prior.symbol AND p2.date >= prior.filed_at
    ORDER BY p2.date
    LIMIT 3
  ) nxt
  WHERE nxt.close < prior.prior_close * 0.95
)
ORDER BY prior.symbol, prior.filed_at
LIMIT 1000

select * from (
WITH p AS (
 SELECT p.symbol, p.date, p.close,
        lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) AS prev_close
 FROM prices p
 WHERE p.symbol = 'AAPL'
)
SELECT f.filed_at AS date,
       p.close / prev_close - 1 AS pct_change
FROM filings f
JOIN p ON p.symbol = f.symbol AND p.date = f.filed_at
WHERE f.symbol = 'AAPL'
  AND f.form_type = '10-K'
  AND prev_close IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.filed_at
) as limited limit 1000

WITH r AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date,
         p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
  FROM prices p
)
SELECT t.symbol,
       COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS big_move_8k_count
FROM tickers t
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT f.symbol, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM r
  JOIN filings f
    ON f.symbol = r.symbol
   AND f.filed_at = r.date
  WHERE f.form_type = '8-K'
    AND ABS(r.pct_change) > 0.03
  GROUP BY f.symbol
) c
  ON c.symbol = t.symbol
ORDER BY t.symbol
LIMIT 1000

WITH r AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date,
         p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_change
  FROM prices p
),
f AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT symbol, filed_at FROM filings WHERE form_type = '8-K'
),
joined AS (
  SELECT r.symbol, r.date,
         abs(r.pct_change) AS abs_return,
         CASE WHEN f.symbol IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS has_8k
  FROM r
  LEFT JOIN f ON r.symbol = f.symbol AND r.date = f.filed_at
  WHERE r.pct_change IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT has_8k, avg(abs_return) AS avg_abs_return
FROM joined
GROUP BY has_8k
ORDER BY has_8k DESC
LIMIT 1000

WITH r AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.date, p.close / lag(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.symbol ORDER BY p.date) - 1 AS pct_return
  FROM prices p
)
SELECT n.symbol, n.headline, r.pct_return
FROM news n
JOIN r ON n.symbol = r.symbol AND n.published_at::date = r.date
WHERE r.pct_return IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY n.published_at DESC
LIMIT 1000

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(p.date) AS max_date FROM prices p
), news_symbols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT n.symbol FROM news n
)
SELECT n.symbol, p.close AS latest_close
FROM news_symbols n
JOIN prices p ON p.symbol = n.symbol
JOIN latest l ON p.date = l.max_date
ORDER BY n.symbol LIMIT 1000

SELECT t.sector, COUNT(*) AS form4_count
FROM filings f
JOIN tickers t ON t.symbol = f.symbol
WHERE f.form_type = '4'
  AND f.filed_at BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY t.sector
ORDER BY form4_count DESC
LIMIT 1000
